title: Cargo van with illegal mineral ore seized in Zamboanga del Norte

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – – Authorities confiscated a wing van loaded with some 481 sacks of illegally sourced mineral ore during a joint operation by the Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office (MENRO)-Sindangan, Office of the Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Officer (OPENRO), and the Sindangan Municipal Police Station on Thursday, Oct. 29. The vehicle was flagged down around 10:45 a.m. in Barangay Ramon Magsaysay, Sindangan town following a tip regarding the loading of bagged mineral ore near the Siayan welcome arc along the boundary of Siayan and Sindangan towns.
